Mexico, you were everything we needed. ☀️🌴🇲🇽

What started as a graduation trip for Donivan turned into a week full of memories I'll cherish forever.

We spent our days snorkeling through crystal-clear water, racing across the ocean on jet skis, soaking up the sunshine, lounging on beautiful beaches, enjoying great food and drinks, and taking in all the incredible shows and vibrant energy that makes Mexico so special. We even squeezed in a golf trip of a lifetime, playing on a breathtaking course with views that looked like they belonged on a postcard.

Watching my son celebrate this huge milestone alongside one of his best friends, while sharing it all with the man I love, made this trip even more meaningful. As a mom, there is something incredibly special about hitting pause on the chaos of life and simply being present for moments like these.

There were laughs until our stomachs hurt, endless sunsets, plenty of adventures, and more than a few moments where I found myself thinking, "I wish I could freeze time right here."

As Donivan prepares for his next chapter and his journey into the Air Force, I'm grateful we got this time together. These are the moments that matter most. Not the schedules, deadlines, emails, or endless to-do lists. The memories. The experiences. The people we love.

Mexico gave us sunshine, adventure, relaxation, and one unforgettable golf experience, but most importantly, it gave us memories that will last a lifetime. ❤️

Congratulations, Donivan. What an incredible way to celebrate the end of one chapter and the beginning of another. The future is bright, and I couldn't be more proud of you. ✈️🇺🇸❤️

Here's to new adventures, lifelong friendships, and making memories you'll carry with you forever.
